2610.13832.title: SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
2610.13832.paper_summary: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. SpatialASM employs an allocentric novel-view generator to ground hypothetical viewpoints in visual evidence and produces two complementary forms of supervision: i) explicit ASM trajectories that teach LVLMs when and how to adaptively invoke view planning and imagination during spatial reasoning, and ii) automatically-constructed perspective-taking tasks that further strengthens viewpoint-conditioned scene imagination. On seven benchmarks spanning relatively perception-oriented spatial understanding to more challenging tasks requiring multi-image, cross-view and viewpoint-transformation reasoning, SpatialASM yields performance gain on LVLMs of four LVLM backbones in spatial reasoning while retaining their original general vision capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves average accuracy across the seven spatial benchmarks. And the synthesis of ASM trajectories provides a scalable pathway to alleviate the scarcity of spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision for eliciting active viewpoint exploration and mental scene simulation.
2610.13832.paper_summary_zh: 在解決複雜的空間推理任務時，普通人類自然會從與任務相關的視角重新回顧場景，並從這些視角中心理重建空間佈局。那麼，大型視覺-語言模型（LVLMs）能否以相同的方式主動思考呢？我們將這種能力稱為主動空間心理化（ASM），這是視覺智能的一個內在組成部分，在當前的LVLMs中仍然相當不成熟。為了彌補這一差距，我們介紹了SpatialASM，一個可擴展的框架，通過訓練時的空間模擬將ASM內化到LVLMs中。SpatialASM使用一個以他者為中心的新視角生成器，將假設的視角基於視覺證據進行定位，並產生兩種互補的監督形式：i) 明確的ASM軌跡，教導LVLMs何時以及如何在空間推理過程中自適應地調用視角規劃和想像，ii) 自動構建的視角採取任務，進一步加強基於視角的場景想像。在七個基準測試中，涵蓋了相對以感知為導向的空間理解到更具挑戰性的任務，這些任務需要多圖像、跨視角和視角轉換推理，SpatialASM在空間推理方面為四個LVLM骨幹的LVLMs帶來了性能提升，同時保留了它們原有的通用視覺能力。實驗結果表明，我們的方法提高了七個空間基準的平均準確率。而ASM軌跡的綜合提供了一條可擴展的途徑，以減輕用於引發主動視角探索和心理場景模擬的空間思維鏈（CoT）監督的稀缺性。
